'''Korczowa''' {{IPAc-pl|k|o|r|'|cz|o|w|a}} is a [[village]] in the administrative district of [[Gmina Radymno]], within [[Jarosław County]], [[Subcarpathian Voivodeship]], in south-eastern [[Poland]],{{TERYT}} close to the border with [[Ukraine]]. It lies approximately {{convert|18|km|mi|0|abbr=on}} east of [[Radymno]], {{convert|29|km|mi|0|abbr=on}} east of [[Jarosław]], and {{convert|77|km|mi|0|abbr=on}} east of the regional capital [[Rzeszów]].

Before [[World War II]] the settlement was a farmstead in Gnojnice which were a suburb of nearby [[Krakowiec]].

The [[Korczowa-Krakovets|Korczowa-Krakovets road border crossing]] with Ukraine is located nearby. As Poland became part of the [[Schengen Area]] on 21 December 2007, this border crossing is a Schengen external border. The [[European route E40]] crosses the border here. The eastern terminus of Poland's [[A4 autostrada (Poland)|A4 motorway]] and [[National road 94 (Poland)|National Road 94]] are located at Korczowa.
